---
name: New example / enhancement
about: Suggest a new Core Java example or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Example] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What concept should the example teach?**
e.g. `CompletableFuture` composition, `ReentrantLock`, records, sealed classes, streams grouping...

**Why is it useful for learners?**
A sentence or two on what makes this worth adding.

**Suggested location**
Which topic package it belongs in, e.g. `com.rsh.jlab.concurrency.<topic>` or `com.rsh.jlab.lambda`.

**References (optional)**
Links to docs, JEPs, or articles that explain the concept.

**Are you willing to submit a PR?**
- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No, just suggesting
